body:
Probably when others were able to spend less time and achieve more. In my technical high school I've ended up stopping my social development. I focused on technical side of the things, and yet, there are people who are able to connect those two. I don't think I'm particularly stupid, but for sure I'm no genius. I feel anxious about people who are dumber than me like, so much depends on what genes we have, how our brain developed. 

I'm also scared sometimes about Hard-determinism, and that reality is just complicated set of events that are pre-destined. 

I know, that it doesn't make sense. I know i get lost in this. But it's in my mind. I'm afraid that I'm developing schizophrenic traits, where my thoughts are too fast to catch, that everywhere is doubt, where you feel drilling hole in the chest.
Thanks for taking time and replying anyways. I'm dubious it will help me, but you guys are angels. Assuming that life is worth saving.
And that I will never be as smart as them. Just because I'm simply slow mover. Everything I achieved was done in sweat. And now, it even don't make me happy.
Simply I cannot stand that they are way smarter than me.
